Experience with developing test strategies, plans, schedules, and work breakdown structures to ensure testing coverage

We are seeking a Business Systems Analyst 4 for a fixed-term, project-focused position supporting the new UCDH CA Tower. This is a full-time position with an anticipated end date on or before December 31, 2030, aligning with the projected completion of the CA Tower project. Employment in this position is directly tied to the lifecycle of the CA Tower project and is expected to conclude upon the project’s completion.
30% - Analysis of Business Needs

The Business Systems Analyst 4 is an experienced professional who knows how to apply theory and put it into practice, with an in-depth understanding of the professional field related to Information Technology – Network, Voice, and Collaboration.
30% - Reporting & Analysis

The incumbent independently performs a full range of responsibilities within the function; possesses broad job knowledge; and is able to analyze problems/issues of a diverse scope, and determine a solution; applies skills as an experienced professional with a full understanding of industry-wide best business practices, along with UCDH organizational policies and procedures. The incumbent evaluates and resolves a wide range of business process issues of moderate to complex scope and demonstrates good judgement in selecting methods and techniques to obtain solutions.
40% - CA Tower Project Support

This position involves technology-based analysis of business practices, processes, and problems related to IT Unified Communications projects. Develops solutions which may involve process design and policy or procedural changes; create specifications for processes and/or systems to meet requirements; validate requirements against needs; planning and executing unit integration and/or end-user acceptance testing; and may develop training materials all as they relate to the CA Tower project.

Incumbent is responsible for requirements development and for providing suggestions/ design for technology to satisfy business needs for the CA Tower project. The incumbent independently performs a full range of responsibilities within the function; possesses broad job knowledge; analyzes problems and/or issues of diverse scope and determines solutions. Applies advanced business analysis concepts to identify, evaluate and define highly complex system scopes and objectives based on advanced knowledge of IT Unified Communications practices, processes, and systems along with industry standards to meet end-user needs related to the CA Tower project. Works at a high technical level throughout various phases of the CA Tower project, requests, and systems analysis and considers the business implications of applying technology to the current and future business environment.

The incumbent assesses existing data, applications, infrastructure, equipment, workflows, and technology to analyze functionality, efficiency, and productivity, and then assists IT Unified Communications with design, development, and implementation solutions as part of the construction of the CA Tower project. The incumbent must have an equal mix of technical knowledge and business acumen. Incumbent must have the ability to identify both business and technical situations, evaluate the needs, and identify potential solutions. This business analyst is responsible for assisting with project planning, budgeting, procurement, scheduling/calendaring and drafting detailed plans and/or technical documentation and be able to take the information gathered and export the information to create metrics, dashboards, and other analytical documents to assist with reporting to IT leadership. Incumbent will also work in conjunction with the IT Unified Communications project managers, as well as other IT department project teams to assist with project support, scheduling, and calendaring for the CA Tower project.

In addition, the Business Systems Analyst acts as a liaison for IT Unified Communications between the business customer, other UCDH departments on the CA Tower project. This role is critical to identifying and driving improvements and efficiency initiatives as it relates to support of the CA Tower project, fostering both intra- and inter-team communication and cooperation.
Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team. Able to effectively and meet deadlines. Demonstrates problem solving skills
Demonstrated skills needed to synthesize information into succinct, concise and logical summaries and reports
Understanding and skill in complex process and systems requirement documentation and standards
Knowledge of Quality Assurance (QA) methodologies; demonstrated testing and test planning skills

Demonstrated skills needed to efficiently develop process and system implementation plans, using common flowchart standards; ability to map out complex processes (after 1-2 meeting sessions with customers) as clear as possible so that the process under review can be readily understood by almost anyone, even someone unfamiliar with the process.
Advanced skills and methodologies associated with process design, modification and implementation
Advanced knowledge relating to the design of process and metrics software
Advanced knowledge of related areas of IT Unified Communications
Advanced knowledge of business and process analysis function
